shortDescription: Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey is preparing his first budget during a crucial autumn for the governing Labour Party, according to Bloomberg. The budget comes as economic pressure rises on Andy Burnham.

title: UK Treasury Braces for John Healey’s First Budget as Labour Faces Pressure
